messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary healthcheck failure detected for rollout id rollout-9843 wave=3
incident-bot: metrics: 5xx_rate=12.3% (threshold 5%), latency_p95=560ms, failing_hosts=8/80
lee: ack - I'm on it, paging SRE
lee: @pagerduty escalate to SRE oncall
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-98765 created and notified to maria
maria: on call — joining. any customer blips reported yet?
sophia: seeing a couple of 5xx error reports in Sentry for chat generation, low volume but real
maria: checking canary dashboard... looks like prefetch timeouts + kv-cache misses spike after ~3s
alan: quick check: can we scale wave3 up, or flip to previous model variant?
lee: runbook step 1: hold traffic to wave3, enable canary-safety-stop flag
lee: runbook step 2: if 5xx > 8% > 5m then kill-switch (feature flag) and roll forward to stable
maria: doing hold now: redwoodctl traffic set --rollout rollout-9843 --wave 3 --hold
maria: searching logs for OOMs
maria: found repeated kvcache eviction errors on hosts host-3[15-18], likely due to quantized model memory regression
sophia: customers impacted: a handful of sessions with truncated responses, CS ticket #5123 opened
lee: decision: flip kill-switch to stop canary wave and fallback to stable model. maria please execute
maria: flipping flag: redwood console -> Rollouts -> rollout-9843 -> AbortWave(3) :thumbsup:
maria: confirmed abort, traffic drained from wave3 and routed back to stable (wave1)
maria: monitoring... 5xx rate dropped to 1.2% across fleet
lee: good. create incident summary and assign postmortem to platform
sophia: creating customer comms draft for affected sessions
alan: will open an infra ticket to investigate kv-cache regression and quantization config
maria: PD-98765 updated: mitigation applied, investigating root cause. no wider customer outage
lee: handing off to maria for overnight triage and postmortem
lee: @maria you're the owner now — can you confirm and note next steps?
maria: confirmed. I'll follow up with logs, reproduce steps on staging, and propose rollback or config revert. assigning to infra team.
maria: tentative timeline: triage today, fix/rollback by EOD tomorrow if reproduces
lee: thanks all, closing active pager. :lock_with_ink_pen:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-98765 acknowledged and marked mitigated by maria
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation applied).
